name: graufence
description: GrauFence — 1v1 online virtual fencing played with your webcam. All computer vision runs locally in the browser; only compact actions cross the wire.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace @graufence/client
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @graufence/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:workspaces
